svg.aria-label: The lit-review mode of the paper skill. Boxes: Intake: you confirm (stop); Literature strategist: each entry checked against an index (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1 (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once (agent, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, after the theme runs: removes the duplicates, searches across the search themes, writes the one review (agent, only when needed); You review the sources, optional (stop); Session: each entry of refs.bib checked against an index again (script); Draft writer: reference fix, when a .tex is given (agent, only when needed); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop).
svg.title: The lit-review mode of the paper skill.
